data.explanation: The other driver involved in your accident on 28.04.2026 has made a liability claim against you, and your insurer needs your account of what happened to assess who is at fault. Fill in the questionnaire (Fragebogen) that came with this letter and send it back by the deadline shown. If you miss it, the insurer may have to decide liability based only on the other side's version, which could work against you. If anything about the accident or the claim is unclear, you can contact the insurer using the phone number or email given, or consult a lawyer.
